name: DscPipelineRunner
description: Test, apply or dry-run a Datum-driven Desired State Configuration with Dsc.PipelineRunner.
helpMarkDown: Requires PowerShell 7 (pwsh) on the agent. [Requirements](https://github.com/ZanattaMichael/Dsc.PipelineRunnerActions/blob/main/docs/requirements.md) and [every setting](https://github.com/ZanattaMichael/Dsc.PipelineRunnerActions/blob/main/docs/settings.md).
author: Michael Zanatta

inputs.name: configurationPath
inputs.label: Configuration path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Directory that holds the Datum configuration (the folder containing Datum.yml), relative to the working directory. Set this or configuration-repository-url, not both.

inputs.name: configurationRepositoryUrl
inputs.label: Configuration repository URL
inputs.helpMarkDown: HTTPS or SSH URL of a Git repository that holds the Datum configuration. The runner clones it. Set this or configuration-path, not both. Requires git on the agent.

inputs.name: configurationRevision
inputs.label: Configuration revision
inputs.helpMarkDown: Branch, tag or commit to check out when configuration-repository-url is set. A full 40-character commit SHA is verified after the clone and is the recommended value.

inputs.name: sourceToken
inputs.label: Source token
inputs.helpMarkDown: Token used to clone configuration-repository-url over HTTPS when the repository is private. Needs read access to that repository only. Supply it from the platform's secret store. Use a secret pipeline variable, for example $(MySecret). A secret variable that is not defined arrives as the literal text $(MySecret); the task reports that.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.label: Mode
inputs.helpMarkDown: Test reports drift and changes nothing. Set applies the configuration. DryRun validates the configuration without calling an engine, connecting to a target or reading a credential.

inputs.name: engine
inputs.label: Engine
inputs.helpMarkDown: DscV2 uses Invoke-DscResource (PowerShell resources; most are Windows-only). DscV3 uses the dsc command-line engine, which must already be installed and on PATH.

inputs.name: engineVersion
inputs.label: Engine version
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional engine version passed to the runner (-EngineVersion). Leave empty for the engine's default.

inputs.name: failOnError
inputs.label: Fail on error
inputs.helpMarkDown: Fail the step when the run status is Failed or Aborted. In Test mode drift counts as a failure, so this makes a Test run a compliance gate.

inputs.name: reportPath
inputs.label: Report path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Directory for the reports (CSV and JSON per node, report.json, and this integration's result.json and outputs.env). Created if missing. Publish it as a build artifact.

inputs.name: connect
inputs.label: Connect
inputs.helpMarkDown: AzureDevOps opens an Azure DevOps session before the run, for configurations that manage Azure DevOps with AzureDevOpsDscNative. That module must be installed (list it in resource-modules).

inputs.name: azureDevopsOrganization
inputs.label: Azure DevOps organization
inputs.helpMarkDown: Azure DevOps organization name. Required when connect is AzureDevOps.

inputs.name: azureDevopsAuthentication
inputs.label: Azure DevOps authentication
inputs.helpMarkDown: How to authenticate to Azure DevOps. PAT needs azure-devops-token. ManagedIdentity needs an agent that runs with an Azure managed identity.

inputs.name: azureDevopsToken
inputs.label: Azure DevOps token
inputs.helpMarkDown: Azure DevOps personal access token (20 to 120 letters and digits). Required when connect is AzureDevOps, authentication is PAT and mode is not DryRun. Supply it from the platform's secret store. Use a secret pipeline variable, for example $(MySecret). A secret variable that is not defined arrives as the literal text $(MySecret); the task reports that.

inputs.name: moduleVersion
inputs.label: Dsc.PipelineRunner version
inputs.helpMarkDown: Exact Dsc.PipelineRunner version to install, for example 1.2.1. Pinning is recommended. Empty uses a version already on the agent, otherwise installs the newest stable release.

inputs.name: allowPrerelease
inputs.label: Allow prerelease
inputs.helpMarkDown: Allow a preview version of Dsc.PipelineRunner (needed when module-version names one, for example 1.3.0-preview1).

inputs.name: moduleRepository
inputs.label: Module repository
inputs.helpMarkDown: Registered PowerShell repository to install modules from. Use this for an internal feed; the repository must already be registered on the agent.

inputs.name: moduleSource
inputs.label: Module source
inputs.helpMarkDown: Where Dsc.PipelineRunner comes from. Gallery installs a published release (module-version, module-repository). Repository clones the module's source repository at module-source-ref, builds it on the agent and runs that build; use it to run an unreleased commit, a branch or a fork. Requires git.

inputs.name: moduleSourceRepository
inputs.label: Module source repository
inputs.helpMarkDown: Git URL of the Dsc.PipelineRunner source repository, used when module-source is Repository. Point it at a fork or an internal mirror if you need to. Its build script runs on the agent, so use only a repository you trust.

inputs.name: moduleSourceRef
inputs.label: Module source ref
inputs.helpMarkDown: Tag, branch or commit of the source repository to build. Required when module-source is Repository. A full 40-character commit SHA is verified after the clone and is the recommended value.

inputs.name: resourceModules
inputs.label: Resource modules
inputs.helpMarkDown: DSC resource modules the configuration uses, one per line or comma-separated, as Name or Name@Version (for example PSDscResources@2.12.0.0). Pinning versions is recommended.

inputs.name: skipModuleInstall
inputs.label: Skip module install
inputs.helpMarkDown: Install nothing. Use on agents or container images where Dsc.PipelineRunner and the resource modules are already present, or where the agent has no access to a module repository.

inputs.name: keepTemporaryDirectory
inputs.label: Keep temporary directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Keep the clone and the compiled per-node YAML on disk after the run, to debug a compile failure.

inputs.name: verbose
inputs.label: Verbose log
inputs.helpMarkDown: Write the runner's verbose log.

outputVariables.name: status
outputVariables.description: Overall run status: Completed, PartialSuccess, Failed or Aborted; or InvalidSettings when the settings were not valid and nothing ran.

outputVariables.name: fail_count
outputVariables.description: Number of resources that failed (in Test mode this includes drift).

outputVariables.name: report_path
outputVariables.description: Absolute path of the report directory.
